title: Muni
desc: A man, with a deep fear of ghosts, moves into a new house unaware of the spirit inhabiting it. When he gets possessed, he must help the spirit get vengeance from the ones who murdered him.

title: Badla Naag Ka 3
desc: A shape-shifting snake-woman in search of her lover whom she lost two decades ago, sets out to win his love again.

title: Jai Simha
desc: Narasimha, a fiery but kind-hearted mechanic, becomes the guardian of an innocent family. Subsequently, he ends up taking on the ruthless kingpin Kariappan and his violent gang to protect them.

title: Shivam
desc: Shiva, the ever-helpful friend, finds himself smitten with Tanu, sparking a love story that stirs up trouble with Bhoji Reddy.

title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest of three siblings, refuses to get married to maintain harmony in his family. However, complications arise after his brothers conspire for him to fall in love.
